readiness.formula: Sources: rows per feed in the billing months the period touches, against the ingest manifest; InvoiceId share of those rows; format, FOCUS version and export mode are the feed's export settings on file; spend in the period on accounts with a sensitivity flag. Tags: cost-weighted coverage per required tag. Accounting: ledger dollars in the period by the basis of the rule that placed them and unmapped; capitalized dollars carrying a valid project code with a start date. Reconciliation: invoices in the period's billing months whose lines all tie within $1, or whose differences are labeled. Controls: C-01 to C-11 as on the Governance page. Each section scores 0 to 100; the overall score is their average.

discovery.title: Proposed Discovery: Data Readiness & Accounting Discovery, 4 weeks
weeks: Receive one closed month per cloud and profile each feed. Review the tag dictionary. Walk through current accounting with Corporate Accounting.
Draft the rule register against your chart of accounts and list the policy items for sign-off. Map the allocation keys to your entities.
Load one closed month and the current open month per cloud into your Snowflake sandbox with the Native Snowflake Pipeline. Allocate them, tie them to invoices and produce the scorecard.
Write the POC charter: scope, success criteria, security package (data path, roles, data classification) and the hand-over of the Client-Owned Codebase.
outputs: Rule register v0.9 mapped to your chart, with the policy items for sign-off
Tag standard with enforcement as code
One month allocated to GL accounts and tied to the invoices
criteria: AWS and Azure invoices tie per InvoiceId within $1, or the gap is labeled
Every policy rule has a named person to sign it off
Known gaps are listed (an Enterprise Agreement carries no InvoiceId)
decisions: The data list below and the dates each item arrives
